Cleanse the southern shrine using the rune, chant MU, take the Moonstone, and meditate.

replies.question: How do I cure paralysis?
replies.text:
GUIDE
Nudge
Not in this guide — from outside research: In Ultima VI, drinking a red potion cures poison and other adverse status effects, while a blue potion awakens an ally who was put to sleep. The first-circle Dispel Magic spell (An Jux Ort; Garlic and Ginseng) also cures poison, removes paralysis, and awakens a sleeping party member.
Outside research (not in this guide): Ultima Codex: Potions — https://wiki.ultimacodex.com/wiki/Potions (checked 2026-10-20); Ultima Codex: Dispel Magic — https://wiki.ultimacodex.com/wiki/Dispel_Magic (checked 2026-10-20).
